# Nested carrier adapters

A sole Object-bounded method formal enters a binary carrier whose other slot
is unbounded, and returns that same outer carrier with invariant Box<T> and
Box<Object> slots. The original provider, input references and opaque result
remain unchanged. Frozen observers check all three consumers, delayed nested
casts, class initialization, exact failures and the original object identities
through direct, compiled-caller, reflection and MethodHandles routes.
